sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position with seven wins from their last six matches prior to that defeat. Alsager Town arrive in poor form, occupying 19th place with just one win all season, making this a favourable fixture for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (2nd, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a key mid-table encounter. Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in another fixture carrying promotion implications, before Brereton Social visit them midweek on Wednesday 7 October. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face Eccleshall at home—a battle between two sides in reasonable form. Bilston Town (6th) entertain Foley Meir (13th) in a fixture between sides separated by several positions. Barnton (7th) host Shawbury United (15th), who are in alarming form with six consecutive losses. New Mills (8th) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th) in a mid-lower table clash. Crewe (16th) face Allscott Heath (11th) at home seeking to climb away from the relegation zone. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) visit Telford Town (18th) in a battle at the foot of the table, and Brereton Social (14th) host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) on Saturday—a golden opportunity for Brereton to secure three points.
